title: Zaha Hadid's Port House: A Floating Crystal Crown Above the City
materials_detail: Steel truss structure; diamond-faceted glass facade panels; two sculptural concrete pillars supporting the crystalline extension above the restored fire station
summary_en: The Port House in Antwerp, completed in 2016 by Zaha Hadid Architects, is the headquarters of the Port of Antwerp. A diamond-shaped glass-and-steel extension appears to float above a restored historic fire station, referencing Antwerp's diamond-trading heritage while consolidating the port authority under one roof. The project achieved a Very Good BREEAM environmental rating and uses a borehole energy system.
